sections.title: I. Read the text carefully and decide whether the statements are true (T) or false (F). (1,25pt)
sections.introHtml: This writing is about my best friend, Mai. We go to the same school and we‛ve been together for three years. Mai is very pretty. She has short black hair and big brown eyes. She is clever and hard-working but she is also very funny. She makes jokes and we all laugh. She loves reading and writing short poems. I like being with her. We often do our homework together and she helps me a lot. I also like her because she knows a lot about astronomy and we can chat about it for hours. At the moment we‛re making a Space mini book. We‛re doing a lot of searching on the Internet. This Saturday we‛re going to the National Museum to take some photos for our project. Then we‛re watching a new ﬁlm on the Disney channel together. It‛s going to be fun

sections.title: II. Read the passage and answer the question (1,25pt)
sections.introHtml: Hi, my name is Anna. This is a photo of my family. There are six people: my grandparents, my parents, my elder brother and me. My grandparents are old and retired. They love gardening and morning exercise. My father is forty-one and a doctor. My mother is thirty-eight and an Art teacher at a secondary school. My brother Jack is sixteen and a high school student. I'm ten, the youngest in my family. We live in a small but lovely house on Nguyen Hue Street. It has a living room, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a kitchen. My favorite part is the big garden and pond behind it, where we relax or fish on weekends.
